verdict.rationale: Runway's pricing docs describe a draft workflow: `draft: true` on text-to-video, image-to-video or video-to-video bills at the cheaper 480p rate, and the chosen preview can then be enhanced to 1080p by passing its `draftTaskId` on text-to-video. Separately, plans include unlimited 4K video upscaling. Missing for 10: the draft-to-1080p enhancement is documented only for text-to-video (not image- or video-to-video drafts), the speed advantage of drafts is not documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
